author: Riilo
body:
Question: When is Atlas being tested?

"We're shooting for Mid to late May, which means testing beforehand. Converting maps to Atlas is another story."
- funkystudios (2 months ago)

Now, when I ask this, don't reply saying "soon". I don't wanna sound impatient but why do Avicus never stick to their words. Now it is the 27th of May AEST, (Currently, as I am making this post) and that means there are 4 more days of May. Is it going to be Early June, or late May, because I don't expect testing to be in the next 4 days? When is Atlas actually getting tested, because you guys have had 2 months, since the announcement, and I'm sure there is at least something you can test for the community. 

Please respond with an answer that isn't, "Soon" or "Later". A specific date, please.


@Admins and Seniors

replies.body: Soon. I can't give out a date as i don't even know if we are going to do public testing or just straight up release it.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
Some testing has been done internally and preparations for the tournament have been made. Map developers are starting to get going on converting maps so proper testing can happen. You're right, we can test some things, but we couldn't earlier in the month because it just wasn't far enough along. It doesn't appear we'll make the anticipated May release, but testing is possible.

If you must know, Javi, ALM and I have all been busy with school, citing exams and finishing up the school year as the main issue.
